original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-cohomology-smooth-projective-curve}
Let $X$ be a smooth projective curve of genus $g$ over an
algebraically closed field $k$ and let $n \geq 1$ be invertible in $k$.
Then there are canonical identifications
$$
H_\etale^q(X, \mu_n) =
\left\{
\begin{matrix}
\mu_n(k) & \text{ if }q = 0, \\
\Pic^0(X)[n] & \text{ if }q = 1, \\
\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z} & \text{ if }q = 2, \\
0 & \text{ if }q \geq 3.
\end{matrix}
\right.
$$
Since $\mu_n \cong \underline{\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z}}$, this gives
(noncanonical) identifications
$$
H_\etale^q(X, \underline{\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z}}) \cong
\left\{
\begin{matrix}
\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z} & \text{ if }q = 0, \\
(\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z})^{2g} & \text{ if }q = 1, \\
\mathbf{Z}/n\mathbf{Z} & \text{ if }q = 2, \\
0 & \text{ if }q \geq 3.
\end{matrix}
\right.
$$

final_content.statement:
Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $n\ge1$ an integer **invertible in $k$** (its residue characteristic does not divide $n$), and $\mu_n$ the étale **$n$-th roots of unity** sheaf on $k$-schemes. For a smooth projective connected $k$-curve $X$ of genus $g$, $\operatorname{Pic}^0(X)[n]$ is the kernel of multiplication by $n$ in the degree-zero Picard group. The Kummer short exact sequence is $0\to\mu_n\to\mathbf G_m\xrightarrow{(\cdot)^n}\mathbf G_m\to0$ on small étale sites. A *smooth projective compactification* of a smooth affine curve $X$ is a smooth projective curve $\bar X$ containing it as a dense open; $r$ is the number of **geometric closed points** of the finite complement. The degree of a nonconstant morphism of smooth projective curves is its function-field extension degree.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-pullback-on-h2-curve}
Let $\pi : X \to Y$ be a nonconstant morphism of smooth projective curves
over an algebraically closed field $k$ and let $n \geq 1$ be invertible in $k$.
The map
$$
\pi^* : H^2_\etale(Y, \mu_n) \longrightarrow H^2_\etale(X, \mu_n)
$$
is given by multiplication by the degree of $\pi$.
